name: Jusratio
description:
Jusratio connects Claude to Brazilian case law and legislation. Search more than 40 million deduplicated decisions from 97 Brazilian courts and public authorities, alongside consolidated legislation structured article by article. Results are ranked by legal authority and linked to their original sources.

Use Jusratio to find relevant and binding precedents, validate legal arguments, identify contrary authorities, compare court positions, review legal documents, and draft well-grounded legal analyses, opinions, briefs, and other legal work with verifiable citations.

Create a free Jusratio account, no credit card required, to get started. Usage limits and available features depend on your plan.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Jusratio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Jusratio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.jusratio.com.br/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Jusratio MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jusratio provides these MCP tools: buscar_legislacao, informativo_juridico, listar_estatisticas_uso, listar_overruling_por_tema, listar_ramos_direito, listar_tribunais, obter_documento, obter_documento_chunk, obter_resultado_pesquisa, pesquisar_documentos, and timeline_decisoes.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Jusratio?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Jusratio in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.
Jusratio requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Jusratio is developed by Jusratio. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
